meta.title: Request a quote: {name}
meta.description: Send the spec, quantities and files for {name}. The getpack team prices it and replies within the stated time.

heading: Request a quote: {name}
intro: Tell us what you need. Our team prices it and sends you a quotation.

how.step1: Give the spec and quantities, attach files
how.step2: We price it and send a quotation
how.step3: Accept the price and order straight away

form.dimensionsHint: Not sure yet? Give a rough size and our team will confirm it.
form.quantitiesHint: Ask for up to {count} quantities to compare
form.filesHint: Sketches, reference photos or artwork help us price it accurately
form.fileRules: Up to {max} each, at most {count} files
form.wrongType: {name} is not a supported file type
form.stillUploading: Please wait for the files to finish uploading
form.notesHint: For example what goes in it, its weight, special finishes
form.sla: Our team replies within {hours} business hours
form.signInNote: When you send it you will be asked to sign in with your mobile number, so our team can reach you. Nothing you typed is lost.
form.fixErrors: {count, plural, one {# thing needs} other {# things need}} fixing
form.failed: We could not send the request. Your answers are still here — please try again.
form.fromProduct: Sent here from {name}: this spec needs our team to price it. Fill in the details below.
form.basketHint: Need prices for several items? Add them to the basket and send once — the team quotes each item in one conversation.

list.title: My quote requests
list.intro: Follow your requests and the quotations our team sends you
list.emptyBody: Products without an instant price can be quoted from their product page.

detail.title: Quote request
detail.heading: Quote request: {type}
detail.submitted: Request {code} sent. We will notify you when the quotation is ready — through the channels set in your notifications.
detail.declinedTitle: We are not able to quote this request
detail.noQuotesYet: No quotation yet — our team is pricing it.
detail.confirmBody: Accept the price for request {code}: {quantity} pieces, {amount} in total incl. VAT. The quantity cannot be changed afterwards, but nothing is paid until you order.
detail.acceptFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
detail.acceptedBody: {quantity} pieces. Add it to your cart to order.
detail.orderedBody: Follow production and payment in your orders
detail.cartFailed: We could not add it to your cart. Please try again.
detail.declinedBody: Chat with us to find another way, such as a different spec or quantity.
detail.withdrawnBody: You can send a new one from any product page

thread.askedForInfo: Our team needs more information. Reply below so we can carry on pricing it.
thread.failed: We could not send the message. It is still here — please try again.

decline.title: Withdraw {code}?
decline.body: The team stops pricing it and any quotation sent can no longer be accepted. A withdrawn request cannot be reopened.
decline.failed: Could not withdraw it. Please try again.

basket.title: Quote request basket
basket.intro: Collect several items the team needs to quote, then send them together. Every item shares one delivery and target date.
basket.added: Added to the basket. Add another item, or send the request.

empty.title: Your basket is empty
empty.body: Choose a product that needs a quote, fill in the spec, then press “Add to quote basket”.

basket.detailsHint: Applies to every item in the basket.
basket.targetDateHint: Optional; it helps the team plan production.
basket.discardBody: The {count} items in it will be deleted; nothing has been sent to the team.
basket.failed: That did not work. Try again.
basket.submitted: {count} items sent. The team quotes each one and tells you in this basket's conversation.
basket.itemAccepted: Quote accepted — it is in your cart
basket.validUntil: Choose a quantity · price valid until {date}
basket.conversation: Talk to the team about this basket
basket.accepted: {count} items added to your cart at the quoted prices
